zx_builder_media_download_error: Unable to download the image. Please try again.
zx_builder_fonts_shared: Catalog shared by active users. You can edit and archive fonts you added; projects retain their own copies.
zx_builder_fonts_project_hint: Select fonts to load in this project and press Apply. Then assign families to tokens in the Fonts section of Style settings.
zx_builder_fonts_family_hint: One family per entry, without quotes. Google Fonts suggests the first family in the link. For Typekit and custom CSS, use the provider’s family name. Multiple families can share a URL.
zx_builder_fonts_invalid: Enter a valid HTTPS URL or a single stylesheet link and a valid family name. Maximum 100 fonts per project.
zx_builder_fonts_changed: This entry has changed. Reopen the library before editing it.
zx_builder_fonts_error: Operation failed. Check your connection, permissions and font library migration.
zx_builder_fonts_load_error: A font stylesheet failed to load. Check the link and provider configuration.
zx_builder_media_global_hint: Personal images reusable across your projects.
zx_builder_media_project_hint: Images shared with members of this project.
zx_builder_media_public_hint: Files are public: anyone with the link can view them.
zx_builder_media_upload_hint: Static JPEG, PNG, WebP or SVG · maximum 10 MB, 40 megapixels and 12000 px per side. Original format preserved. You can also paste an image (Ctrl+V, or ⌘V on Mac).
zx_builder_media_archive_hint: Archiving hides the file from the library; images already in use remain available.
zx_builder_media_error: Unable to complete the operation. Check the media configuration and try again.
zx_builder_media_unconfigured: Image storage is not configured: set the persistent directory and public URL on the server.
zx_builder_media_unauthorized: Sign in with an active account and check your project permissions.
zx_builder_media_too_large: The image exceeds the 10 MB limit.
zx_builder_media_invalid: Invalid image: use static JPEG, PNG, WebP or SVG within the stated limits.
zx_builder_slider_bound: Bound or custom value: use advanced properties.
zx_builder_slider_unknown: Custom content: edit it in the advanced JSON.
zx_builder_slider_inherit: Leave empty to use the Base value. The placeholder shows the Base value when available.
zx_builder_slider_advanced_params: This configuration uses native or custom parameters. Edit them in advanced properties.
zx_builder_style_base_hint: Use Base for shared decorative styles. Select a viewport to edit layout, dimensions, spacing and positioning.
zx_builder_style_image_hint: Set the frame dimensions or aspect ratio to control cropping.
zx_builder_style_object_invalid: Enter two X Y coordinates, e.g. 30% 70% or 10px 20px. Unitless numbers use pixels.
zx_builder_format_code_error: Unable to format the code. Correct the source and try again.
zx_builder_format_html_error: Unable to format this HTML. Correct the source and try again.
zx_builder_richtext_hint: Visual edits save HTML. Unsupported markup is normalized; use Text / HTML to edit the source.
zx_builder_storage_error: Storage unavailable. Export your work to keep a copy.
zx_builder_recovery: The existing save cannot be read. It has been preserved; autosave is paused.
zx_builder_conflict: Another tab changed the workspace. Choose which version to keep.
zx_builder_copy_notice: This is an independent copy. Changes apply only to this template.
zx_builder_library_notice: You are editing the library definition. Existing copies remain independent.
zx_builder_select_hint: Select an element in the preview to edit its properties.
zx_builder_drag_hint: Drag an element onto the page. The center nests it inside containers; the edges insert it before or after.
zx_builder_empty_hint: Insert a ZVC from the library or create a blank component.
zx_builder_outline_drag_hint: Drag to the row edges to insert before or after; to the center of a container to add inside it. The line shows the destination.
zx_builder_invalid_json: Invalid JSON. Correct it before applying.
zx_builder_fields_hint: Fields define the configurable data of your ZVC. Bind them to element properties.
zx_builder_no_fields: This ZVC has no configurable fields yet.
zx_builder_field_used: This field is still bound to a property. Remove the binding first.
zx_builder_field_exists: The key is invalid or already in use.
zx_builder_export_hint: JSON preserves all editable data. The JS package includes the ZVC, metadata and default values.
zx_builder_import_hint: Load JSON exported from Zaux Studio or a component with name and props (optional children). Components and templates are appended; a complete workspace replaces the current session after confirmation.
zx_builder_replace_workspace: Replace the current workspace? You can export it first to keep a copy.
zx_builder_delete_confirm: Delete this item? You can restore it with Undo.
zx_builder_last_template: Keep at least one template in the workspace.
zx_builder_invalid_document: The document does not match the builder format.
zx_builder_invalid_simple_json: The JSON is not in the simple Zaux format (name, props and optional children and fields).
zx_builder_invalid_key: The JSON contains a prohibited key.
zx_builder_file_too_large: The file exceeds the 5 MB limit.
zx_builder_library_empty: Your library is empty. Create your first ZVC.
zx_builder_css_hint: Component CSS. Use specific classes to avoid affecting other sections. Included as a CSS file in the JS package.
zx_builder_preview_error: A component could not be displayed. Check its properties.
zx_builder_css_error: New CSS classes could not be compiled. Please try again shortly.
zx_builder_library_drag: Drag onto the page to insert a copy
zx_builder_source_base_notice: This base comes from project files. Insert a copy into a template or create a configurable library copy.
zx_builder_source_notice: Content values are independent. The ZVC file defines structure and conditions. Visual conversion preserves the current result and can be undone.
zx_builder_source_structure: This ZVC structure is defined in code. Convert a copy to visual editing to add or move elements.
zx_builder_source_fields: Fields are defined in the .meta.js file. Configure their values in the Content tab.
zx_builder_source_missing: The source file is unavailable. Preview preserves the last saved result. Restore the file or convert to visual editing to continue.
zx_builder_native_invalid: The ZVC module must expose ZVCName and buildNode and return valid Zaux nodes.
zx_builder_palette_blocked: This component is not enabled in the palette.
zx_builder_palette_hint: A selection of elements for visual composition.
zx_builder_json_editable_hint: ComponentsRenderer wrappers and Zsection component content become Structure nodes, editable like builder-inserted elements. Other properties stay unchanged.
zx_builder_runtime_hint: Nodes ready for Zaux rendering, with current values. Use editable JSON to resume work in Studio.
zx_builder_styles_hint: Edit project tokens and see the preview. Component colors control content; Editor colors control the interface. Changes are saved in this browser and can be undone.
zx_builder_style_json_hint: The cssVars format is compatible with Zaux ConfigStyles. You can also edit advanced UI settings; Apply replaces the current preset and can be undone.
zx_builder_invalid_style_preset: Invalid preset. Check cssVars, selectors, --zx-* names and variable values.
zx_builder_clipboard_error: Clipboard access failed. You can download the CSS file.
zx_builder_account_unavailable: User profile is unavailable. Contact an administrator.
zx_builder_account_disabled: This account is not enabled for the builder.
zx_builder_remote_conflict_notice: The project changed elsewhere. Export local work before loading the cloud version.
zx_builder_login_hint: Sign in with an account enabled for Zaux Studio.
zx_builder_component_json_hint: Paste a Studio ZVC definition (id, name, exportName, fields, tree, css) or an exported component JSON envelope. Add creates a new library copy.
zx_builder_component_simple_hint: Paste a component in the compact Zaux format: name (the component to render), props and, optionally, children, fields and label. The library name follows label, then ZVCName/ZVPName, then name. Values stay literal; use {"$bind": "key"} to bind a field. Conversion to a ZVC definition happens automatically.
zx_builder_delete_project_confirm: Delete project "{name}" from the server? Shared access will also be removed. This cannot be undone. The open workspace remains available as a local copy.
zx_builder_project_changed: The project has changed, was deleted or is no longer accessible. Reload the project or refresh the page before trying again.
zx_builder_style_hint: Each choice edits classes at the selected breakpoint. Breakpoints apply from their minimum width upward. "Not set" removes the local rule: base, component or other breakpoint styles may still apply. Change the preview viewport from the canvas toolbar.
zx_builder_style_dynamic: Edit bound classes or conditional class objects in the property editor. Visual controls preserve these values.
zx_builder_style_advanced_hint: Custom classes, hover variants and inline styles remain in the advanced editor and can affect the result. For a directional gradient, also choose start and end colors; Zaux presets already define their colors.
zx_builder_hub_intro: Your projects and projects shared with you, ready to open in Zaux Studio.
zx_builder_hub_empty_hint: Start in the local workspace and save it as a new project from the editor menu.
zx_builder_hub_load_error: Unable to load projects. Try Refresh list again.
zx_builder_hub_project_unavailable: Unable to open the project. It may have been deleted or may no longer be accessible.
zx_builder_hub_action_error: The operation failed. The server has not confirmed the changes. Try again.
zx_builder_hub_delete_confirm: Delete project "{name}"? Shared access will also be removed. This cannot be undone.
zx_builder_hub_leave_error: Resolve the saving issue before leaving the editor.
zx_builder_style_length_invalid: Enter a CSS length. Numbers without units use pixels; Z does not accept percentages.
zx_builder_style_dimension_invalid: Enter a non-negative CSS length. Numbers without units use pixels.
zx_builder_restore_library_hint: Restore structure and styles while keeping data and properties. Properties of unmatched nodes remain available below. You can revert with Undo.
zx_builder_restore_library_missing: The original ZVC is no longer in the library.
zx_builder_overlay_trigger_hint: Select the panel by its ID. Drag the button into the trigger in Structure and use Preview to open it.
zx_builder_theme_preview_hint: Interact with the component to see hover and focus. Sample size, background and properties are not saved in the project.
zx_builder_theme_variable_hint: Placeholders come from Zaux SCSS. Enter an override or clear it to restore the original cascade. Color variables may require RGB channels such as 255 0 0, or var(--zx-color-set1-accent). State and size selectors keep their original conditions.
zx_builder_theme_pending: You have a CSS draft: apply or discard it in CSS source before editing variables.
zx_builder_theme_css_hint: This is the same source used by the Variables controls. You can add CSS, comments and media queries. Apply to save and update previews; exports include only applied CSS. Styles affect previews without changing Studio. Include exported CSS after Zaux styles in the destination project.
zx_builder_theme_invalid_css: Invalid CSS: check brackets, declarations and values. The draft was not applied.
zx_builder_theme_props_pending: Apply or discard the JSON draft before using the controls.
zx_builder_theme_props_empty: Use the preview toolbar to change this component’s theme and size.
zx_builder_theme_preview_missing: Preview not configured: define a prop preset for this component.
zx_builder_starter_hint: All library and template ZVCs and ZVPs, templates with stories, edited tokens, CSS overrides, UI settings and font references. Select a file to preview it. The README explains how to integrate them into a Zaux repository.
zx_builder_starter_error: Unable to generate the starter package. Check the project definitions.
zx_builder_partial_json_hint: Paste a Studio ZVP definition, an editable JSON export or a component envelope. A project ZVP will be created, preserving its fields and values.
zx_builder_partial_simple_hint: Paste a component in the compact Zaux format: name, props and, optionally, children, fields and label. The library name follows label, then ZVPName/ZVCName, then name. Conversion to a ZVP definition happens automatically.
zx_builder_partial_restore_hint: Restore structure, fields and styles from the library while preserving this occurrence's data. Other instances remain independent.
zx_builder_partial_original_missing: The original ZVP is no longer in the library.
zx_builder_preview_open_error: Unable to open the preview: local storage is unavailable.
zx_builder_preview_unavailable: Preview unavailable. Check the project and selected template.
zx_builder_drag_copied_node: Drag onto the canvas or outline; click to paste after the selection
